main_text.p: concordiæ inter Magistratum & mi-nistros in eo confistit, ut pastores jus suum eripiant Magistratui; è contrario nullum est majus incentivum discordiæ[?], quam cùm quis Magistratum, imò quemvis minimum ex fæce[?] Romuli spoliat jure suo, & eum impe-dit, quo minus exercere illud possit; Societas quippe humana, ait optimè Sib-brandus p. 150. conservari nequit nisi quisque sese intra limites suæ vocationis continęat. Vera autem concordia inter Magistratum & ministerium eo fundamento nititur, ut neutra pars invadat jus alterius, sed utraque alteri, quod suum est, tribuat. Quod quidem fit per hanc doctrinam, quam consequenter pastores tenentur non tacere nedum impugnare, sed diligenter & fideliter populis proponere, & ipsi ad usum perpetuò revocare. page.notes: The page number "125" at the top right is uncertain; the last digit is hard to read. The running head reads "Q. XIV. Constantini Magni." with a flourished Q. Several letters in the text are doubtful: "discordiæ" (printed cordiç), "fæce" (printed fçce), and the mark after "doctrinam" (printed as a dash or flourish). Some words in the text are set in italic, and the italic runs are marked accordingly. The Google "Digitized by" watermark at the bottom right is omitted.
